target.exact_identity: Dengfu R20 Disc Gravel Bike Frame

accepted_source.finding: The exact R20 product page links the R20 Gravel Geometry R7 chart. It supplies four frame sizes and these printed columns: SIZE, ST, TT, HT, HA, CA, BB drop, RC, FC, FL, OFFSET, WB, STACK, REACH, STR. 47/XS: 450, 514, 105, 70°, 74.5°, 80, 436, 595.5, 399, 55, 1018.5, 535, 366, 1.46; 51/S: 470, 531, 120, 70.5°, 74°, 80, 436, 603.5, 399, 55, 1027, 551, 373, 1.48; 54/M: 490, 552, 140, 71.25°, 73.5°, 80, 436, 612.5, 399, 55, 1036, 573, 382, 1.50; 57/L: 520, 572, 165, 71.75°, 73.5°, 80, 436, 629, 399, 55, 1052.5, 598.5, 395, 1.51. The chart does not label linear units, so the values remain verbatim and unnormalized. An exact-string follow-up search found no independent corroborating geometry source.

field_results.finding: The public product page says the frame can be customized but shows no price or exact quote. No contact form or private inquiry was submitted.
field_results.reopen_when: A dated public exact-R20 listing or an authorized public price schedule appears.

field_results.finding: The exact product page does not publish R20-specific material grade, layup, or construction. Generic Dengfu company copy was not treated as model-specific material evidence.
field_results.reopen_when: An exact R20 product specification or manual identifies material and construction.

field_results.finding: The official R7 geometry image does not include frame weights, and the exact product page publishes no size/finish weight.
field_results.reopen_when: A dated exact-R20 manufacturer weight schedule or transparent exact-frame measurement is available.

field_results.finding: The product page and R7 chart do not publish a tire maximum. No value was transferred from another Dengfu gravel model.
field_results.reopen_when: An R20-specific manufacturer maximum or a documented exact-frame fit measurement appears.

field_results.finding: Added all four official R7 geometry rows to the candidate detail as a verbatim table transcription. The chart does not label linear units; no conversion or unit normalization was made. Independent exact-model corroboration was not found in this pass.
field_results.reopen_when: Dengfu confirms the linear units or a separate exact-R20 geometry source corroborates the table.

field_results.finding: The chart's BB drop is a geometry measurement, not a bottom-bracket shell standard. The page gives no shell, axle, headset, or seatpost standards.
field_results.reopen_when: An exact R20 specification lists the component interfaces and standards.

field_results.finding: The official page exposes a customization route but does not enumerate included parts or R20-specific warranty/support coverage. The general brand warranty is not assumed to cover this exact model or China-market seller.
field_results.reopen_when: A public exact-R20 package list and model/market-specific support terms are published.

delivery_boundary: Local only; no push, pull request, merge, publication, or seller/manufacturer contact.
